speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome)

Given your recent history of urethritis and the specific pattern of asymmetric joint inflammation affecting the ankle and now the knee, combined with your sexual history, this clinical picture strongly suggests Reactive Arthritis. I will need to confirm this with specific lab tests and possibly imaging.
